entities.name: Lat-Nam Straits
entities.description: A body of water in western Terisian Isles separating Lat-Nam and the Halquina Islands from Almaaz and Gulmany.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent beside which the straits formed before it split.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: Glacier that covered much of the straits' area in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: Small nation formed near the straits in the Dark Age.

entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: Small nation formed near the straits in the Dark Age.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event after which glaciers retreated and the straits filled again.

events.summary: During the Ice Age the straits dry up completely, connecting Lat-Nam to the main continent.
events.quote: During the Ice Age , the straits dried up completely, connecting Lat-Nam to the main continent.

events.summary: With the Flooding of Terisiare the glaciers retreat and the straits fill with water once more.
events.quote: filling the straits with water once more
